title: Handle null task executor config in API responses (#49071)
body:
**Title:** Handle null task executor config in API responses (#49071)

## Summary
Mapped task instance responses expect `executor_config` to be serialized as a string, but database rows can contain `NULL` when a Dag/task explicitly sets executor config to `None`. This normalizes that edge case to the existing empty-config representation for mapped task lists and try details, so the UI receives a usable value throughout the mapped task view.

## Changes
- **`airflow-core/src/airflow/api_fastapi/core_api/datamodels/task_instances.py`** -- convert `None` executor config values to `"{}"` before response validation.
- **`airflow-core/src/airflow/api_fastapi/core_api/datamodels/task_instance_history.py`** -- apply the same conversion for task try details used by the mapped task Details tab.
- **`airflow-core/tests/unit/api_fastapi/core_api/routes/public/test_task_instances.py`** -- add mapped-task regressions for list and mapped try-details responses when `executor_config = None`.
- **`airflow-core/newsfragments/69158.bugfix.rst`** -- add a bugfix release note for the user-facing API behavior.
